document.title: S6 Value & Receiving Legacy Language Cleanup Notes
document.status: Non-blocking source cleanup recommendations; commercial overlay is already cleaned
document.note: Original symbolic source fields remain unchanged. This file identifies legacy wealth/resources/财富 language still present in source fields so Nova/Lumen can prevent accidental public rendering.
